ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows time increasing upward on the vertical axis and phenotypic divergence increasing horizontally on the bottom axis. A single ancestral lineage begins near the bottom and branches upward into multiple separate descendant lineages near the top, representing nine species. Roman numerals I through V mark different areas or levels of the branching pattern. Reasoning: The question states that the figure represents a single species introduced to a remote, newly formed island. In the diagram, that single ancestor diversifies into many phenotypically different descendant species. This pattern is the evolutionary process called adaptive radiation.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note that time increases upward and phenotypic divergence increases horizontally, and that one ancestral species at the bottom gives rise to many separated descendant lineages near the top. Then combine this with the text statement that the figure shows nine species evolving from a single ancestral species. The key bridge is that diversification of one ancestor into many phenotypically different species is called adaptive radiation. Therefore the process is adaptive radiation.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows one lower ancestral lineage on a time-versus-phenotypic-divergence plot branching into numerous upper lineages, with the terminal species separated along the divergence axis. Then focus on the textual condition that the ancestor was introduced to a remote, newly formed island. A new island provides unoccupied ecological opportunities, and isolation allows descendants of one colonist to specialize and diverge. The process matching a single colonist producing many island species adapted to different niches is adaptive radiation.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中纵轴标为 Time，横轴标为 Phenotypic Divergence。图的底部只有一条祖先谱系，随后向上分支，形成多个终端谱系；这些终端谱系在横向的表型分化轴上彼此分开。罗马数字 I 和 II 标出上方不同的分支区域，III、IV、V 标出右侧不同时间或分化阶段。整体模式表现为一个共同祖先逐渐分化成九个不同物种。推理：题干说明这是单一物种被引入一个偏远、新形成的岛屿后的情况。新形成的岛屿通常有许多未被占据的生态位，地理隔离也有利于后代种群分化。一个祖先物种在不同生态位中快速分化并形成多个适应不同环境的物种，这一过程称为适应辐射。
